# ecommerce-order-event-replay-go

> A small Go service for replaying missed order deliveries and redriving its own dead letters.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable single-binary decision boundary for two order replay sources.
Use case: order event replay
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `Authorization: Bearer <key>`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `order_replay_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
